intuition: The required chain follows preorder, so a left subtree must be moved before the original right subtree.

brute_force.approach: Collect preorder nodes in an array, then reconnect each node to the next array entry.

optimal.approach: For each node with a left child, splice the left subtree's rightmost predecessor before the original right subtree.

edge_cases: The tree may have no left children and already be flattened.
The original right subtree must be preserved before relinking.
All left pointers in the final structure must be None.
